mainEntity.name: Are the work from home jobs at UltraModern Technologies permanent or contractual?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most remote roles are permanent positions on our payroll, not short-term contracts or freelance arrangements. We hire for the long term.

mainEntity.name: Can I apply if I live outside a major city?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our remote jobs are open to candidates from anywhere in India. Several team members work from Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities.

mainEntity.name: What is the working hours expectation for remote employees?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most remote roles require a 4–6 hour overlap with our Indore-based team, roughly between 10 AM and 4 PM IST. Outside that window, your schedule is more flexible.

mainEntity.name: Do you hire freshers for remote positions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for certain roles. Content writing, SEO, customer support, and education counseling are areas where we hire freshers with demonstrable interest.

mainEntity.name: Is there any in-person requirement for remote roles?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most remote roles, in-person attendance is not required. We organize occasional all-team meetups, discussed openly during hiring.

mainEntity.name: How do remote employees communicate with their teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Day-to-day communication happens through Slack and Google Workspace. Video calls are used for design reviews, sprint meetings, and presentations.

mainEntity.name: Are remote employees eligible for the same benefits as office-based staff?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Remote employees are part of the same team structure and receive the same consideration for appraisals, promotions, certifications, and performance bonuses.

items.q: Are the work from home jobs at UltraModern Technologies permanent or contractual?
items.a: Most remote roles are permanent positions on our payroll, not short-term contracts or freelance arrangements. We hire for the long term and expect the same from team members.

items.q: Can I apply if I live outside a major city?
items.a: Yes. Our remote jobs are open to candidates from anywhere in India. Several team members work from Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities. As long as you have a stable internet connection and can attend video calls during overlap hours, location is not a barrier.

items.q: What is the working hours expectation for remote employees?
items.a: Most remote roles require a 4–6 hour overlap with our Indore-based team, roughly between 10 AM and 4 PM IST. Outside that window, your schedule is more flexible. We don't measure attendance by hours logged.

items.q: Do you hire freshers for remote positions?
items.a: Yes, for certain roles. Content writing, SEO, customer support, and education counseling are areas where we hire freshers with a demonstrable interest in the field. Development and design roles typically require some prior project experience, even if it's personal or academic work.

items.q: Is there any in-person requirement for remote roles?
items.a: For most remote roles, in-person attendance is not required for day-to-day work. We do organize occasional all-team meetups, and some senior or client-facing roles may require periodic travel. This is discussed openly during the hiring process.

items.q: How do remote employees communicate with their teams?
items.a: Day-to-day communication happens through Slack and Google Workspace. Client communication follows project-specific protocols. Video calls are used for design reviews, sprint meetings, and client presentations.

items.q: Are remote employees eligible for the same benefits as office-based staff?
items.a: Yes. Remote employees are part of the same team structure and receive the same consideration for appraisals, promotions, certifications, and performance bonuses.

items.q: What kind of internet connection is required?
items.a: A stable broadband connection with enough bandwidth to support video calls is the baseline requirement. We recommend at least 10 Mbps for consistent performance.
